draft_text: Varga & Sandoval (2021) reported that salience pre-filtering reduced the share of news summaries containing an unsupported entity by 31% relative to an unfiltered summarizer, across three news summarization benchmarks.
rationale: P1 (the only cited passage) describes the salience pre-filtering method (scoring threshold, training data, application) but contains no hallucination-reduction percentage, no 31% figure, and no mention of three benchmarks. The 31% figure appears only in the Methods summary as an unverified attribution ("often credited with... about 30%"), not as a reported result from Varga & Sandoval. No statistical test or table supports it.

judgement.strongest_supported: The package does not support any version of this claim: P1 describes the filtering method but reports no hallucination-reduction figure, no 31% value, and no three-benchmark evaluation.
